Now we start to make a round-shaped pillow
Create a diameter of 230mm
Then engrave a layer and turn it over to add pressure
Have a look at the result
Put a piece of new fabric on the round-shaped sheet
Cut the end of the thread
Reduce the strength of the sand and reduce the strength of the corner line to 1, and the board will expand into a ball through pressure.
If the strength of the corner line is increased a little, the ball will be a little flat.
When the strength of the corner line is reduced to 0, the board will become completely round, like a ball.
Continue to carve a layer to make the color of the outside of the abacus.
Change the sewing line between the boards to Custom Angle, so that the boards can be sewn together without leaving any gaps.
Then cancel the connection between the boards of the abacus, because it will adjust the size of the outer board later.
Now there is still a gap between the boards, because the sewing line between the boards has not been changed to Custom Angle.
Reduce the strength of the two-layer board to 10 or 8, otherwise the fabric wrinkles will not appear.
Apply a new fabric to the outer layer.
Change the sewing line between the boards to 5 or 6, and the board will become completely round.
Then cancel the connection between the boards.
Increase the strength of the corner line of the outer board to 5, so that the border will also wrinkle a little.
Then turn it over and press it up.
Then reduce the particle diameter to 5, so that the fold is more detailed
If you think there are not enough folds around the sewing line, you can use the ruler tool to increase the shrinkage to 3
Create along the outer line
Finally, the seam line has a circle of folds
contribution beam
The board about the creation has a smaller circle of fold around, but the goal is a circle that is defined
If you want to use a T-shaped fold that has more depth, you can add a felt to help bounce the sewing line
Chatipare sewing line tool will create a circle around the line
You can also use the line-cut line function, but the line-cut line function will randomly open and extend, which will lead to the line-cut line extending along the curve to the outside of the board.
You can use the edit line function to select the excess lines and delete them.
Then drag a point of the line to the starting position to complete the edit.
This video ends here. See you in the next video.
summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Furniture Item Production P06 - Making a Round Pillow ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will create a round-shaped pillow using Marvelous Designer. Follow the steps to achieve the desired shape and texture. ## Creating the Base 1. **Start with the Diameter**: Create a diameter of **230mm** for the pillow. 2. **Engraving**: Engrave a layer and then turn it over to apply pressure. ## Fabric Application 3. **Applying Fabric**: Place a piece of new fabric on the round-shaped sheet. 4. **Thread Management**: Cut the end of the thread to prepare for sewing. ## Adjusting Strength Settings 5. **Strength Settings**: - Reduce the strength of the sand and the corner line to **1**. This adjustment will allow the board to expand into a ball through pressure. - If the strength of the corner line is increased slightly, the ball will become a bit flat. - When the strength of the corner line is reduced to **0**, the board will become completely round, resembling a ball. ## Layer Carving 6. **Carving Layers**: Continue to carve a layer to create the color on the outside of the abacus. 7. **Sewing Line Adjustment**: Change the sewing line between the boards to **Custom Angle**. This change allows the boards to be sewn together without leaving any gaps. ## Size Adjustment 8. **Connection Management**: Cancel the connection between the boards of the abacus, as the size of the outer board will be adjusted later. 9. **Identifying Gaps**: Note that there is still a gap between the boards because the sewing line has not been changed to **Custom Angle**. ## Board Strength Modification 10. **Strength Reduction**: Reduce the strength of the two-layer board to **10** or **8**; otherwise, the fabric wrinkles will not appear. 11. **Outer Layer Fabric**: Apply a new fabric to the outer layer. 12. **Sewing Line Adjustment**: Change the sewing line between the boards to **5** or **6** to ensure the board becomes completely round. ## Final Adjustments 13. **Connection Cancellation**: Cancel the connection between the boards once again. 14. **Corner Line Strength**: Increase the strength of the corner line of the outer board to **5** to allow for slight wrinkling of the border. 15. **Final Pressing**: Turn the pillow over and press it up. ## Detail Enhancement 16. **Particle Diameter Adjustment**: Reduce the particle diameter to **5** for more detailed folds. 17. **Folds Around Sewing Line**: If additional folds are needed around the sewing line, use the ruler tool to increase the shrinkage to **3** and create along the outer line. ## Conclusion 18. **Seam Line Folds**: Finally, ensure the seam line has a circle of folds. 19. **Contribution Beam**: The board concerning the creation will have a smaller circle of folds around it, with the goal being a defined circle. 20. **T-Shaped Folds**: To create a T-shaped fold with more depth, consider adding felt to support the sewing line. ## Tools and Functions - **Chatipare Tool**: This sewing line tool will help create a circle around the line. - **Line-Cut Function**: Be cautious with the line-cut function as it can randomly open and extend, potentially leading to undesired shapes. - **Edit Line Function**: Use this function to select and delete excess lines. After editing, drag a point of the line back to the starting position to complete the edit. ## Closing This video concludes the tutorial on making a round pillow. Thank you for watching, and see you in the next video! ```
